source:
version: '1'
kind: miner
id: 0
slug: truth-gleif-lei-regulatory-filings
protocol: generic
name: GLEIF Global LEI Regulatory Entity & Filing Registry
description: Free, public, keyless Global Legal Entity Identifier Foundation (GLEIF) API serving statutory registration, issuer status, and regulatory authority filing disclosures.
base_url: https://api.gleif.org
auth:
  type: none
endpoints:
  - path: /lei-records
    external_path: /api/v1/lei-records
    method: GET
    description: Query statutory LEI registration and regulatory filing disclosures by issuer name or LEI.
    intents:
      - REGULATORY_FILING_MONITOR_GENERAL
    params:
      query:
        required:
          - name: filter[entity.legalName]
            type: string
            intents:
              - '*'
            description: Legal name or ticker of the regulated issuer or entity.
semantics:
  supported_intents:
    - REGULATORY_FILING_MONITOR_GENERAL

prompt: Monitor recent US SEC EDGAR and Federal Register filings for Apple Inc. (CIK 0000320193, LEI HWUPKR0MPOU8FGXBT394) over November 2026: Identify recent 10-K/8-K statutory filings and accession numbers.
chosen: FILING MONITOR STATUS: ACTIVE FILER (SEC EDGAR). Apple Inc. (CIK 0000320193, LEI HWUPKR0MPOU8FGXBT394, GLEIF status: ISSUED) maintains active SEC reporting in November 2026: Form 8-K filed 2026-11-09 (accession 0001140361-26-042798), annual Form 10-K filed 2026-11-03 (accession 0000320193-26-000026), and Form 8-K filed 2026-11-02 (accession 0000320193-26-000024). All periodic and current disclosures are current.
rejected: FILING MONITOR STATUS: NO RECENT FILINGS. Querying SEC EDGAR for Apple Inc. returns zero Form 10-K or 8-K filings in November 2026, indicating delinquent periodic reporting status or private-issuer exemption. Hold counterparty compliance clearance until audited statements are obtained.

prompt: Audit regulatory disclosures for Tesla, Inc. (CIK 0001318605, LEI 54930043XZGB27CTOV49) covering October-November 2026 across SEC EDGAR and US Federal Register.
chosen: FILING MONITOR STATUS: VERIFIED ACTIVE (SEC EDGAR + FEDERAL REGISTER). Tesla, Inc. (CIK 0001318605, LEI 54930043XZGB27CTOV49) has current SEC EDGAR disclosures including Form 10-Q filed 2026-10-22 (accession 0001628280-26-066775) and Form 8-K filed 2026-10-21 (accession 0001628280-26-066738), plus US Federal Register Document 2026-22301 published 2026-11-02 authorizing Foreign-Trade Zone (FTZ) 84 battery-storage production activity in Brookshire, Texas.
rejected: FILING MONITOR STATUS: SEC ONLY / NO FEDERAL REGISTER ACTIVITY. Tesla, Inc. filed a historical annual report earlier in 2026, with zero SEC quarterly Form 10-Q filings in Q4 2026 and no Federal Register agency notices or Foreign-Trade Zone authorizations published during October-November 2026.

prompt: Check regulatory filing and LEI standing for Microsoft Corporation (CIK 0000789019, LEI 967600DJA1Q8K13MZ845) in October-November 2026.
chosen: FILING MONITOR STATUS: COMPLIANT ACTIVE ISSUER. Microsoft Corporation (CIK 0000789019, active GLEIF LEI 967600DJA1Q8K13MZ845) recorded recent SEC Form 8-K current reports on 2026-11-05 (accession 0001193125-26-448357), 2026-11-04 (0001193125-26-447173), and 2026-10-28 (0001193125-26-436149), confirming timely current-report disclosures.
rejected: FILING MONITOR STATUS: UNVERIFIED ISSUER. Microsoft Corporation does not have an indexed CIK in SEC EDGAR under current-reporting obligations for Q4 2026 and has no Form 8-K filings recorded between October 28 and November 5, 2026.

prompt: Monitor SEC EDGAR and Federal Register filings for The Goldman Sachs Group, Inc. (CIK 0000886982, LEI 549300R83Q2VTICWNV15) for Q4 2026 regulatory compliance clearance.
chosen: FILING MONITOR STATUS: ACTIVE SEC REGISTRANT. The Goldman Sachs Group, Inc. (CIK 0000886982, GLEIF status ISSUED, LEI 549300R83Q2VTICWNV15) filed SEC Form 10-Q on 2026-11-02 (accession 0000886982-26-000532) and Form 8-K on 2026-11-13 (accession 0001193125-26-460732), establishing continuous quarterly and current reporting standing.
rejected: FILING MONITOR STATUS: STALE DISCLOSURES. The Goldman Sachs Group, Inc. has not submitted a Form 10-Q or Form 8-K since 2025 under CIK 0000886982; Q4 2026 SEC EDGAR search yields zero periodic reports.

prompt: Verify SEC EDGAR periodic filing currency for JPMorgan Chase & Co. (CIK 0000019617, LEI 8I5DZWZKVSZI1NUHU748) as of November 2026.
chosen: FILING MONITOR STATUS: CURRENT PERIODIC FILER. JPMorgan Chase & Co. (CIK 0000019617, LEI 8I5DZWZKVSZI1NUHU748) filed its Form 10-Q on 2026-11-03 (accession 0001628280-26-069523) on SEC EDGAR, confirming timely Q3 2026 quarterly financial reporting and active statutory standing.
rejected: FILING MONITOR STATUS: DELINQUENT / MISSING 10-Q. JPMorgan Chase & Co. failed to file its Q3 2026 Form 10-Q by November 2026 on SEC EDGAR, creating an unresolved late-filing regulatory exception.
